skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit Ch'en wore during her Dossoles holiday.
Also worn when carrying out certain missions, with a sense of vacation strong enough that she can catch you off guard.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
Artificial sea, sandy beaches, competitions—all things that have absolutely no draw to Ch'en. It's in other ways that this vacation left a deep impression on her.
And to other people, when Ch'en's occasionally worn this outfit, it's left a deep impression on them too.

skins.name: Holiday HD79
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HD79. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.
skins.usage: One of Ch'en the Holungday's summer outfits.
skins.quote: Still very much enjoying her holungday. Mind the bubbles. Caution: Wet Floor.

skins.name: Ten Thousand Mountains
skins.content: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Ten Thousand Mountains. Ch'en Hui-chieh entered the capital on a starry night, and left before sunrise after settling matters. She bid farewell to old friends and took a sampan down the river, the lamp on the prow crashing through the fog and night.
skins.usage: One of Ch'en the Holungday's outfits for crucial moments.
skins.quote: 'My thanks to you two Tianshi for accompanying me on my journey so far, but it's about time we went our separate ways.'
